ios.desc:
Immerse yourself in CodenQuest, the all-in-one coding app that fuses programming practice, bite-sized lessons, and gamification to elevate your coding journey. Now featuring concise JavaScript and Python lessons similar to Mimo, CodenQuest helps you learn to code step by step with interactive exercises and real-time feedback. Whether you’re an aspiring developer, a seasoned pro, or someone prepping for technical interviews, CodenQuest offers the perfect environment to sharpen your skills in web development, software engineering, and data science.

Key Features:
Bite-Sized Lessons: Dive into structured JavaScript and Python tutorials designed to simplify complex topics. From basic syntax to more advanced concepts, our lessons promote efficient learning and logical problem-solving.

Diverse Coding Challenges: Explore over 200 coding puzzles spanning multiple languages, including Java, TypeScript, Kotlin, Swift, Rust, PHP, Ruby, Go, and C++. Daily challenges reinforce best practices and ensure steady progress.

Engaging Gamification: Earn points, maintain streaks, and battle for the top spot in weekly coding leagues—rising from Bronze to Challenger. Challenge yourself with algorithm puzzles and coding exercises that keep you motivated.

Premium Membership: Upgrade to access unlimited challenges, a coding assistant, and an ad-free interface. Tackle intricate problems on the go and craft custom test cases to fine-tune your skills.

Enhanced Code Editor: Enjoy a robust coding experience optimized for iOS:
Multi-Language Autocomplete: Intelligent suggestions across 11 languages.
iOS-Specific Shortcuts: Snippet jumping, custom arrows, and adaptive scrolling for streamlined coding.

Personalized Environment: Clear navigation and organized coding spaces to help you focus on problem-solving.
Community & Competition

Join a thriving network of coders, compare solutions, and climb leaderboards. Every code submission morphs into a mini-competition, fueling your growth as you learn to code faster and more effectively.

Who Benefits from CodenQuest?

Aspiring Coders: Break away from dull tutorials and embrace gamified lessons in JavaScript, Python, and more—perfect for interview prep and building solid fundamentals.
Professional Developers: Keep your skills fresh in languages like PHP, Rust, and Go with quick, on-the-go coding challenges that fit your schedule.
Advanced Programmers: Push boundaries with complex problems, analyze performance metrics, and compete in top-tie

show_hn.title: Show HN: Practice Leetcode problems on your phone

quotes.text:
Hello everyone,

I've been working on a project called CodenQuest, a coding practice app inspired by platforms like LeetCode, but with a major twist: it's heavily gamified, similar to Duolingo. The main goal is to make coding practice more engaging, especially on mobile. Key Features:

- Diverse coding questions with integrated hints and timers.
- Code editor with code completion and fill in the blanks questions
- Performance statistics (runtime, memory, CPU usage, and more).
- Gamified elements: leagues, ranking systems, daily challenges, friends, and streak mechanisms.
- Available on iOS and the Web.

I’ve put a lot of energy in this project and I am personally proud of the final look. I'd be grateful if you could take the time to check it out and give your valuable feedback.

Thank you so much!

iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/codenquest/id1671648294

Web: https://codenquest.com/
